title.en: An Act Setting Aside An Appropriation of thirty-Five thousand Pesos for the Employment of Personnel in the Bureau of Lands to Verify the Surveys Executed By Private Land Surveyors, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
The sum of thirty-five thousand pesos is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the Insular
Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the employment of junior computers, junior draftsmen, and clerks at
the rate not to exceed six hundred pesos per annum each: Provided, however, That the payments made under
the authority given herein, shall not exceed the fees which may actually be collected under section one of Act
Numbered Thirty-seven hundred and sixteen.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 13, 1931.
